collection.title: Vauxhall Astra Hatchback 2015 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Astra Hatchback 2015 - 2021 requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 24" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Astra, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
